name: Scar
source: After growing up with nothing, Scar left the orphanage ready to change his life for the better. Little did he know things could get a lot worse. A decade later, he's a drifter who will accept any job he can find just to make ends meet. Perpetually overworked and chronically sleep deprived.
translation: After growing up with nothing, Scar left the orphanage ready to change his life for the better. Little did he know things could get a lot worse.
